connector.name: Agent Trust MCP
connector.registryDescription: ERC-8004 agent trust scores via x402: free preview + paid USDC-on-Base signed scores (5 chains)
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package agent-trust-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nikoble1926 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Optional. Base wallet private key (0x...) for a low-balance hot wallet with a little USDC. Required only for the paid tool; the free get_trust_preview works without it. Never use your main wallet.

env.name: RESOURCE_SERVER_URL
env.description: Optional. Override the trust API base URL. Defaults to https://trust.nsgoods.org.
